entityListLabel: tracks, playlists, artists, genres, or listeners on a music streaming service
outOfScopeDescription: anything unrelated to searching/filtering tracks, playlists, artists, genres, or listeners on a music streaming service - e.g. general knowledge, cooking, weather, small talk

explicit.description: whether the track has explicit content

created_by_me.description: the caller's own playlists - 'my playlists', 'playlists I made', no other person involved

track_count.description: how many tracks the playlist has

artist.description: Musicians and bands with tracks on the service

verified.description: whether the artist's profile is verified

monthly_listeners.description: how many monthly listeners the artist has

genre.description: Musical genres tracks are categorized under

track_count.description: how many tracks belong to the genre

listener.description: Registered listeners / accounts on the service

premium.description: whether the listener has a premium subscription
